description: Defines the HttpRouter template class for HTTP request routing, including URL parsing, handler management, and route matching logic within the uWS namespace.

classes.name: HttpRouter
classes.description: A template class implementing HTTP request routing with URL pattern matching, handler registration, and route execution.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Routes an HTTP request based on method and URL, executing matching handlers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a route with specified methods, pattern, handler, and priority.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes routes matching the specified method, pattern, and priority.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns URL parameters extracted during route matching.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description: Provides access to the user data associated with the router.
